title: Final summary: Dallas blues and Texas as a birthplace of jazz
summary: Parker says the Doughboys differed from eastern bands through kinship with Dallas blues, Lead Belly and Blind Lemon and closeness to the Gulf. He calls Texas a separate birthplace of jazz.

story.theme_name: Where jazz stands today: young players, rock, and the audience
story.community_name: What the word "jazz" means: origins, Dixieland and labels
